title: A Day at the Funfair
description: Practise past simple and fun words, and write about a day at the funfair.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about a funfair day in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🎡 We sat on the big ___ and saw the whole town.
exercises.explanation: The big wheel goes round and up high.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ to the funfair on Saturday. (go)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Tom rode on the roller coaster.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Lucy buyed a big ice cream.
answers: Lucy bought a big ice cream.

exercises.text: The roller coaster was ___ than the train.
exercises.explanation: Scary becomes scarier when we compare two things.

exercises.text: 🎠 The music ___ loud and everybody was happy.
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with one thing in the past.

exercises.text: This is the ___ ride in the funfair. (fast)
exercises.explanation: Add -est for the number one: the fastest.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: We did not see the clown.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: see.

exercises.text: ___ you have fun at the funfair?
exercises.explanation: Use "Did" to ask a question about the past.

exercises.text: We laughed ___ on the bumper cars. (loud)
We met our friends ___ the gate at ten o'clock.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We saw two clowns and three childs.
answers: We saw two clowns and three children.
exercises.explanation: The plural of child is children.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Nam ___ a big teddy bear in the game. (win)

task.prompt: Write about a day at the funfair.
task.modelAnswer: Last Saturday I went to the funfair with my cousin Hoa. We rode on the big wheel and the bumper cars. Then we ate popcorn and ice cream. The roller coaster was very scary but fun. It was a great day!
